item.text: I’ll use Fructal Cap Design to check both ID visibility findings against the fixture and keep each recommendation local to the affected view.

Both findings have the same priority. Your report identifies approval as required and attributes stalls to the missing ID. The fixture confirms only `state=blocked`. It does not identify the cause or show which omission costs more time. [Fixture record](./workflow.txt)

1. **Status message.** You report that the message omits the approval record ID, leaving the requester without a precise reference to quote when asking for help. Include the existing ID as selectable text labeled “Approval record ID.”
2. **Support view.** You report that the view hides the same ID, making it harder for support staff to confirm which record a requester means. Make the ID visible in the record details under the same label.

Both recommendations preserve the required approval and change only how its existing identifier is displayed.
